note: The root kernels' mutation gate (witness v0.6, pinned) runs on GitHub's runner on every push (.github/workflows/gate.yml, the proof-of-play workflow), and tools/witness-check.mjs fails the build unless each run is clean AND re-derives exactly these counts. No survivor is baselined: every mutant of every root kernel must die. LIGHT's kernels have their own receipt, light/data/witness.json.
